title: Typography / office and screen examples
slide_intent: Test type in real reading contexts so a family choice serves both identity and information.
strategic_value: The same DB signature can connect a personal business card and a digital information panel.
demonstration: A portrait business card sits beside a dark information panel headed Sondervermögen gut investiert.
practical_value: Compare name hierarchy on a small printed object with heading, paragraph and button hierarchy on screen.

content_islands.name: Business card
content_islands.spec: Place the portrait, name and small identity details on the white card at left.

content_islands.name: Digital panel
content_islands.spec: Place a white headline and paragraph above a red button on the dark panel at right.

reference_purposes.Application: The specimens show type used on a business card and digital content panel.
